# proxmox_node_time (Resource)

Sets the node timezone through `PUT /nodes/{node}/time`. Import as the node name; destroy keeps the last timezone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_time" "tz" {
  node     = "pve-1"
  timezone = "Europe/Berlin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone such as `Europe/Berlin`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Node name.
- `localtime` (Number) Node-local epoch time.
- `time` (Number) Current epoch time reported by the node.
